drifted.spec_text: Server MUST accept multiple client connections but serialize request processing (one request at a time). Serialization is achieved via a Mutex around the dispatcher reference.
drifted.actual: The dispatcher reference is wrapped in Arc (not Mutex). Serialization only occurs at the IPC cache Mutex and pending_stores Mutex. Multiple gRPC requests can execute concurrently on the tokio runtime via spawn_blocking; they only serialize on shared state access. This is actually better behavior but diverges from the stated serialization guarantee.

drifted.spec_text: System MUST support --memory-tier-size accepting human-readable sizes (K/M/G suffixes, case-insensitive). Default is 2 GiB.
drifted.actual: The parse_size() function supports K/M/G suffixes correctly. However, the CLI help text says 'Defaults to 256M' (line 44 comment) while the actual default constant DEFAULT_MEMORY_TIER_SIZE is 2 GiB (2 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024). The code is correct (2 GiB default) but the help text is misleading.

The batch_size histogram is recorded via record_op() which passes the 'op' attribute correctly. However, the ops_total counter records the total entry count per batch rather than incrementing by 1 per batch operation. This means ops_total counts entries, not operations. The metric semantics are: 1 batch of 100 entries records ops_total += 100 rather than ops_total += 1.

unspecced.description: A 3-phase store protocol allowing clients to reserve memory, DMA copy from GPU, then commit or abort. Not covered by any spec.
unspecced.suggested_spec: Create new spec 004-split-phase-store or add to 001-grpc-dispatcher-server

unspecced.description: Pin increments a reference count to prevent eviction; Unpin decrements it. Pin supports a 'promote' field that fire-and-forget promotes SSD-resident entries to memory tier after pinning. Not covered by any spec.
unspecced.suggested_spec: Create new spec 005-pinning or add to 001-grpc-dispatcher-server

unspecced.description: Non-blocking poll that drains eviction events from a crossbeam channel. Reports dropped_count for events lost due to channel overflow. Constructor accepts eviction_rx and eviction_dropped. Not covered by any spec.
unspecced.suggested_spec: Create new spec 006-eviction-events or add to 001-grpc-dispatcher-server

unspecced.description: Creates a bounded crossbeam channel (capacity 16384) via disp_comp.create_eviction_channel() and tracks dropped events via AtomicU64. Infrastructure supporting TakeEvents.
Memory-tier pool is bound to the NUMA node of the first selected drive (resolves via SPDK device list). Not mentioned in any spec.
unspecced.suggested_spec: Add to 002-operational-config as a new FR covering NUMA affinity
